result.summary: Several visual/layout problems: truncated restaurant names, an odd '-100%' badge, cut-off category chips, and a partially clipped popular item card.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with missing letters in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line / detail view so names are fully readable.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' badge, which looks like a broken or incorrect discount label.
issues.suggestion: Verify promo logic and display a clear offer (e.g. '100% off' or 'Free') or hide invalid percentages.

issues.description: Category filter chips are cut off on the right edge (partial chip visible after Healthy).
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll affords full chips or add padding/fade so the last visible chip isn’t clipped awkwardly.

issues.description: The bottom popular item (pizza) card is heavily clipped by the viewport/tab bar, so most of the image and any title below are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards aren’t obscured by the fixed tab bar, and ensure scroll area clears the nav.

issues.description: Delivery time pills sit over food images with light backgrounds that can reduce image clarity and contrast consistency across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize overlay contrast (stronger scrim or solid pill) so labels stay readable on all imagery.
